mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.TRIP_ID) FROM TRIP t
INNER JOIN TRIP_DETAIL d ON t.TRIP_ID = d.TRIP_ID
SELECT TRIP_ID, USER_ID, TRIP_NAME, START_DATE, END_DATE, IS_AI_ROUTE, SHARE_CODE, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT FROM TRIP WHERE TRIP_ID = #{tripId}
mapper.update: UPDATE TRIP SET TRIP_NAME = #{tripName}, START_DATE = #{startDate}, END_DATE = #{endDate}, IS_AI_ROUTE = #{isAiRoute}, SHARE_CODE = #{shareCode} WHERE TRIP_ID = #{tripId}
mapper.select: SELECT DETAIL_ID, TRIP_ID, CONTENT_ID, CONTENT_TYPE_ID, SPOT_NAME, CATEGORY, ADDRESS, SIGUNGU_CD, LATITUDE, LONGITUDE, VISIT_TIME, VISIT_DATE, ESTIMATED_STAY, THUMNAIL, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT FROM TRIP_DETAIL WHERE TRIP_ID = #{tripId} ORDER BY VISIT_TIME ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE TRIP_DETAIL SET CONTENT_ID = #{contentId}, CONTENT_TYPE_ID = #{contentTypeId}, SPOT_NAME = #{spotName}, CATEGORY = #{category}, ADDRESS = #{address}, SIGUNGU_CD = #{sigunguCd}, LATITUDE = #{latitude}, LONGITUDE = #{longitude}, VISIT_TIME = #{visitTime}, VISIT_DATE = #{visitDate}, ESTIMATED_STAY = #{estimatedStay}, THUMNAIL = #{thumnail} WHERE DETAIL_ID = #{detailId}
